title: share_difference
guidance: For two categories sharing one total: (first-second)/total. A decimal answer keeps that fraction; percent multiplies by 100 once. Do not confuse this with relative growth over the second category.

title: decimal_scale
guidance: A decimal ratio is the fraction, not the percentage number: 25%=0.25. Preserve the unrounded fraction; round only after the requested scale is fixed.

title: polynomial_fit
goal: Complete source series before polynomial forecasting
guidance: Fit only the specified observations with an intercept; keep the target actual outside the fit. Use all required months. A polynomial of degree d needs at least d+1 distinct x values.

title: difference_value
guidance: Subtract matching categories and units: signed change is new minus old; absolute difference takes abs only when requested.

title: rolling_range
goal: Rolling statistic over the full requested scope
guidance: Keep months in order and years in separate groups. Compute each full rolling window, then pooled max minus min across the requested groups. Do not report a min-to-max interval.

title: normalized_midpoint
guidance: Midpoint-normalized difference is abs(b-a)/((abs(a)+abs(b))/2). Keep the decimal fraction unless a percent conversion is explicitly requested.

title: compound_growth
goal: Source-bound compound growth and final percent display
guidance: CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed_years)-1. Count intervals, not rows. Percent per year means multiply by 100 once and display %; do not round endpoints.

title: annual_log
guidance: Continuous relative change is ln(end/start). Divide by elapsed years only for an annualized rate; otherwise use one interval. It is not an absolute currency difference.

title: absolute_deviation
when: mean of the absolute differences|mean absolute deviation|average absolute deviation
goal: Absolute deviation from the stated benchmark
guidance: Average absolute deviation from a benchmark is mean(abs(value-benchmark)); retain all requested dates. Percentage-point inputs stay at that magnitude; a unit of measure need not be a suffix.

title: dispersion
goal: Select the statistical population before calculation
guidance: For all stated years use population divisor n. Use n-1 only for an explicitly requested sample estimate. Do not change the convention after computing.

title: regression_coordinates
goal: Source-bound linear fit and signed forecast error
guidance: Fit the requested years only, in the stated t coordinates. Keep forecast_x and its actual value outside fitting periods. Preserve the requested forecast-minus-actual sign.

title: paired_series
guidance: Pair both observed series by the same period and adjustment basis. Do not fill a missing external series from memory. A correlation needs both actual series.

title: series_scope
goal: Mean over exactly the requested periods
guidance: Use exactly the requested periods and category for a mean. Preserve blank columns; exclude adjacent totals, duplicated months and forecast observations.

title: log_trim
guidance: Apply the requested logarithm first, sort, remove floor(n*proportion) values per tail, then average the retained values. Take the total column, not a financing component.

title: median_deviation
guidance: Compute the median of the complete selected series, then average absolute distances from that median. Verify revisions before fixing the series.

title: theil
guidance: For positive observations, Theil T is mean((x/mean(x))*ln(x/mean(x))). Round the computed result normally; do not truncate to fit an expected-looking value.

title: revision_basis
goal: Choose the matching revision before binding cells
guidance: For an overlapping historical observation, compare later retrospective tables before choosing the value. Honor an explicit as-of release first; otherwise use the latest same-definition revision.

title: total_scope
guidance: A total may be in the continued panel; do not substitute its largest component. Reporting in dollars does not restrict a category to dollar-denominated assets.

title: table_groups
guidance: Count blank cells as columns. Read the full year/category header above a repeated month. Bind the exact row in that group, not the first matching month elsewhere.

title: typed_submission
guidance: For a final native Python quantity, emit JSON answer={value:unrounded_number,scale:quantity|fraction|percent|percentage_points,unit:literal_unit}. Copy its published quantity_ref to typed_scalar; choose output scale explicitly. Otherwise finish normally.
